name: writing-pack
summary: Scoped editing and translation with explicit metadata, terminology and style evidence.

rubric.text: Required document metadata is present and agrees with the supplied rules.
The document passes the supplied terminology rules; unresolved usage decisions are identified for person review.
The document passes the supplied mechanical style rules; readability and audience fit have a separate reviewer judgment.

checks.note: Manual, advisory example only: bun templates/checks/writing.mjs <document.json> <rules.json>. Output is evidence, not publication approval.
